title: New Media Manager
overview: As a New Media Manager, you'll be responsible for managing key media channels, including podcasts, analyst outreach, and awards across multiple client accounts. You'll develop deep knowledge of client companies, their products, spaces, and executives while helping shape their public narrative.

sections.heading: What Makes a Great New Media Manager?
points: Strong communication and organizational abilities demonstrated through previous experience
Native-level English with exceptional writing capabilities
Quick learner who can adapt to various technology spaces
Creative approach to problem-solving and content creation
Genuine enthusiasm for technology and current events
Drive to contribute to the success of Israeli startups

sections.heading: What You'll Do
points: Develop and execute media strategies across multiple channels
Manage podcast appearances and speaking opportunities
Coordinate award submissions and analyst relations
Create compelling narratives that align with client objectives
Track and report on media coverage and campaign success

title: Senior Account Manager
overview: As a Senior Account Manager, you'll be a driving force behind major stories for some of the most exciting Israeli and international tech startups. You'll apply your media expertise to secure valuable results across multiple client accounts, from creating media strategies to writing press releases and pitching journalists. Working with our team of technology and media experts, you'll have the freedom to execute strategic and creative decisions while receiving strong support.

sections.heading: What Makes a Great Senior Account Manager?
points: Native-level English with strong writing capabilities
At least two years experience in tech PR or startup communications
Proven track record of delivering high-level media results
Strong interpersonal skills and leadership in collaborative projects
Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities
Passion for technology and current events
Drive to impact the success of promising Israeli startups

sections.heading: What You'll Do
points: Craft compelling press releases and effective media pitches
Lead media outreach and secure valuable coverage
Collaborate with executives to define PR and media strategy
Serve as the main point of contact for company executives
Handle client communications and set realistic expectations
Execute strategic and creative decisions with team support
